title: Integrate combo48 on b3d7dce1: 8e1f d6b83728 byte-identical carry (w-6e81, supersedes combo45 w-639494aeb9cd)
outcome: The candidate is on master as one commit, gated by a full launcher run on the exact tree, pushed, and installed on Central and DL560.
acceptance: Commit 225a5335f937b41aec62fd4ca9da338b3a7d3b6a (tree fca4e0e62d0b67df5f5a2c403ca02831e41b98ef) is on origin/master, where master was moved to it by a fast-forward from b3d7dce13cea176cca544aa1bd5b2961b3aa48ec, and its raw no-renames diff against that parent is byte-identical to 8e1f d6b83728's diff against bcf66e4d.

The release binary built from tree fca4e0e6 was installed at target/release/termal(.exe) on Central and DL560, with the previous binary kept aside, and the running hosts were not restarted by the install; a later landing's install or a host restart's `cargo run --release` rebuild may since have replaced it, and only a replacing install keeps the replaced binary aside.
